tldr_zh: OpenAI發布GPT-5.6模型性能突破、微軟Meta力推AI代理，中東局勢升溫
tldr_en: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 breakthrough, Microsoft and Meta push AI agents as Middle East tensions escalate

items.title_zh: OpenAI GPT-5.6三倍提升ARC-AGI基準分數
items.title_en: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Triples ARC-AGI-3 Benchmark Scores
items.summary_zh: OpenAI通過兩項API設定調整，使GPT-5.6在ARC-AGI-3基準測試中的分數提高了三倍，顯著提升推理保留和資料壓縮效率。這表明簡單的設定優化可帶來顯著的性能改進。
items.summary_en: OpenAI improved GPT-5.6 performance on ARC-AGI-3 benchmark by three times through two API setting adjustments, enhancing reasoning retention and data compaction efficiency. Simple configuration optimizations yielded significant performance gains.

items.title_zh: OpenAI向十萬名學者免費提供ChatGPT進階模型
items.title_en: OpenAI Grants 100,000 Academic Researchers Free Advanced ChatGPT Access
items.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布向全球十萬名學術研究者免費提供ChatGPT最先進的AI模型，以加速科學研究、協作與發現。此舉旨在促進學術界與AI技術的結合，推動科學進步。
items.summary_en: OpenAI provides free access to advanced ChatGPT models for 100,000 academic researchers worldwide to accelerate scientific research, collaboration, and discovery. This initiative aims to bridge academia and AI technology to advance scientific progress.

items.title_zh: OpenAI發布GPT-5.6融合前沿智能與效能
items.title_en: OpenAI Launches GPT-5.6 with Frontier Intelligence and Efficiency
items.summary_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-5.6，改進了模型、推理和代理工作流的AI效能，在提供更強大智能的同時降低成本。該模型致力於每美元提供更多有用的AI能力。
items.summary_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-5.6, improving AI efficiency across models, inference, and agentic workflows while reducing costs. The model aims to deliver more useful intelligence per dollar of compute.

items.title_zh: 微軟推出Copilot超級應用整合多項AI能力
items.title_en: Microsoft Confirms Copilot 'Super App' Launch This Year
items.summary_zh: 微軟CEO薩提亞·納德拉宣布將在今年推出Copilot超級應用，整合聊天、編程和代理功能，涵蓋消費者和商業用戶。應用將支援從聊天到協作工作再到自動化的全面升級。
items.summary_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announces the launch of a Copilot 'super app' this year, integrating chat, coding, and agentic capabilities for both consumer and commercial users. It represents Copilot's evolution from chat to collaboration to automation.

items.title_zh: Meta計畫推動個人AI代理商用化
items.title_en: Meta Plans Major Push Into Personal AI Agents
items.summary_zh: Meta CEO馬克·祖克柏在財報電話會中預見未來五年內數十億人將使用個人AI代理。Meta正投入數十億美元建設AI基礎設施，力圖將代理技術商業化。
items.summary_en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg previews a vision of billions of people using personal AI agents within five years. The company is investing billions in AI infrastructure to commercialize agentic AI technology.

items.title_zh: 微軟與OpenAI投資表現分化，自研AI模型競爭力增強
items.title_en: Microsoft's Competing AI Investments Show Diverging Results
items.summary_zh: 微軟Q4財報顯示，其對Anthropic的投資回報32億美元，但對OpenAI的投資表現不佳。微軟同時推出自有AI模型與工具，與OpenAI和Anthropic直接競爭。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's Q4 earnings reveal a $3.2B return from Anthropic investment while OpenAI returns were mixed. Microsoft is now openly competing with OpenAI and Anthropic through its own AI models and tools.

items.title_zh: 高通宣布九月起調漲芯片價格
items.title_en: Qualcomm Announces Smartphone Chip Price Increases Starting September 1st
items.summary_zh: 高通CEO克里斯蒂亞諾·阿蒙宣布從九月一日起調漲所有處理器產品價格。此舉將進一步推高下一代手機製造成本，加上記憶體漲價，新機價格預期上揚。
items.summary_en: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon announces price increases on all processor products starting September 1st. The move will further increase smartphone production costs, adding to memory price hikes already driving up phone prices.

items.title_zh: Xbox營收下滑13%，微軟雲端AI業務成長強勁
items.title_en: Xbox Revenue Drops 13% While Microsoft's Cloud and AI Business Surges
items.summary_zh: 微軟Q4財報顯示Xbox遊戲及服務營收下滑10%，硬體銷售更跌13%。與此同時，微軟的雲端與AI業務表現強勁，成為公司增長的主要動力。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's Q4 earnings show Xbox content and services revenue down 10% and hardware sales down 13%. Simultaneously, Microsoft's cloud and AI business surges, becoming the company's main growth driver.

items.title_zh: OpenAI總裁透露正開發多款AI硬體設備
items.title_en: OpenAI President Says Company Is Building 'Family of Devices'
items.summary_zh: OpenAI總裁格雷格·布羅克曼在訪談中透露，OpenAI正開發一系列AI設備，預計包括傳聞中的2027年推出的智慧音箱。公司將涉足硬體領域與OpenAI模型互動。
items.summary_en: OpenAI President Greg Brockman reveals the company is developing a 'family of devices' for interacting with AI models, potentially including a rumored 2027 smart speaker launch.

items.title_zh: 中東局勢升溫，美伊衝突擴大
items.title_en: Middle East Tensions Escalate as US-Iran Conflict Expands
items.summary_zh: 美國與沙烏地聯手空襲伊拉克境內親伊朗民兵，伊朗隨後向約旦美軍基地發射飛彈。美資液化天然氣船在埃及港口遭無人機襲擊起火，中東衝突呈現擴大跡象。
items.summary_en: US and Saudi Arabia conduct airstrikes on Iranian-backed militias in Iraq; Iran responds by firing missiles at US bases in Jordan. A US-owned LNG vessel catches fire after drone attack in Egyptian port, showing regional escalation.

items.title_zh: 台積電首度躋身財星全球百大企業
items.title_en: TSMC Enters Fortune Global 500 Top 100 for First Time
items.summary_zh: 美國財星雜誌公布2026年全球500強榜單，台積電首度進入前百大企業排行，獲益於全球AI熱潮。緯創排名也躍升至198名，是今年進步最大的台灣企業。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's TSMC enters Fortune Global 500's top 100 for the first time, benefiting from the global AI boom. MediaTek also surges to rank 198, making it Taiwan's most improved company this year.

items.title_zh: Google推出Lyria 3.5音樂生成模型新功能
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Launches Lyria 3.5 with Enhanced Music Generation
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind推出Lyria 3.5音樂生成模型在Google Flow Music中的應用，涵蓋音樂性、歌詞、人聲和創意控制的多項進展。提升了AI生成音樂的質量與創意靈活性。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind launches Lyria 3.5 in Google Flow Music with advances in musicality, lyrics, vocals, and creative control, enhancing the quality and creative flexibility of AI-generated music.
